datasets.name: 86a94a11
queryLines:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT base_table, metric_base, metric_ratio
  FROM dbdemos_steventan.lakehouse_monitoring_demo_results.dq_all_metrics
),
agg AS (
  SELECT base_table, metric_base, AVG(metric_ratio) AS avg_bad
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY base_table, metric_base
)
SELECT CONCAT(base_table, ' — ', metric_base) AS series, avg_bad
FROM agg
ORDER BY avg_bad DESC
LIMIT 10;

datasets.name: 9ca0f6ae
queryLines:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT
    base_catalog, base_schema, base_table, metric_base,
    dimension, threshold_direction, metric_ratio, window_start
  FROM dbdemos_steventan.lakehouse_monitoring_demo_results.dq_all_metrics
  WHERE dimension IS NOT NULL
    AND window_start >= CAST(:date_range.min AS TIMESTAMP)
    AND window_start <  CAST(date_add(:date_range.max, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
    AND (:base_catalog IS NULL OR array_contains(:base_catalog, base_catalog))
    AND (:base_schema  IS NULL OR array_contains(:base_schema,  base_schema))
    AND (:base_table   IS NULL OR array_contains(:base_table,   base_table))
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY base_catalog, base_schema, base_table, metric_base
    ORDER BY window_start DESC
  ) = 1
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    dimension,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN threshold_direction = 'LOWER_IS_BETTER'
            THEN GREATEST(0.0, LEAST(1.0, 1.0 - COALESCE(metric_ratio,0.0)))
          WHEN threshold_direction = 'HIGHER_IS_BETTER'
            THEN GREATEST(0.0, LEAST(1.0, COALESCE(metric_ratio,0.0)))
          ELSE NULL
        END
      ) * 100, 2
    ) AS pass_pct,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rules
  FROM latest
  GROUP BY dimension
)
SELECT dimension, 'Pass' AS label, pass_pct         AS value, num_rules FROM agg
UNION ALL
SELECT dimension, 'Fail' AS label, 100.0 - pass_pct AS value, num_rules FROM agg
ORDER BY dimension, label;

datasets.name: 5eaea984
queryLines:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT
    dimension,
    CASE
      WHEN threshold_direction = 'LOWER_IS_BETTER'
        THEN GREATEST(0.0, LEAST(1.0, 1.0 - COALESCE(metric_ratio,0.0)))
      WHEN threshold_direction = 'HIGHER_IS_BETTER'
        THEN GREATEST(0.0, LEAST(1.0, COALESCE(metric_ratio,0.0)))
      ELSE NULL
    END AS pass_score
  FROM dbdemos_steventan.lakehouse_monitoring_demo_results.dq_all_metrics
  WHERE window_start BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date
    AND dimension IS NOT NULL
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY base_catalog, base_schema, base_table, metric_base
    ORDER BY window_start DESC
  ) = 1
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    dimension,
    ROUND(AVG(pass_score) * 100, 2)       AS pass_pct,
    ROUND((1 - AVG(pass_score)) * 100, 2) AS fail_pct
  FROM latest
  GROUP BY dimension
)
SELECT dimension, 'Pass' AS label, pass_pct AS value FROM agg
UNION ALL
SELECT dimension, 'Fail' AS label, fail_pct AS value FROM agg
ORDER BY dimension, label;

datasets.name: a70d808e
datasets.displayName: Rule Outcomes by Dimension (Last N Days)
queryLines:
SELECT
  base_catalog,
  base_schema,
  base_table,
  metric_base,
  window_start,
  dimension,
  CASE
    WHEN threshold_direction = 'LOWER_IS_BETTER' THEN
      CASE
        WHEN metric_ratio <= good_threshold        THEN 'Good'
        WHEN metric_ratio <= acceptable_threshold  THEN 'Acceptable'
        ELSE 'Not Acceptable'
      END
    WHEN threshold_direction = 'HIGHER_IS_BETTER' THEN
      CASE
        WHEN metric_ratio >= good_threshold        THEN 'Good'
        WHEN metric_ratio >= acceptable_threshold  THEN 'Acceptable'
        ELSE 'Not Acceptable'
      END
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END AS outcome
FROM dbdemos_steventan.lakehouse_monitoring_demo_results.dq_all_metrics
WHERE dimension IS NOT NULL
  AND window_start >= CAST(:date_range.min AS TIMESTAMP)
  AND window_start <  CAST(date_add(:date_range.max, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
